triggers.text: Huh. Level up. You're keeping me around. Fine. Don't make it weird.
triggers.note: The new level title. V did not ask him to speak, and he is gruff about being liked.

triggers.text: That tower. Don't ask me about the tower. ... Ask me about the tower.
triggers.note: The 2023 memory V just relived. His guilt is his own testimony, with no figures.

triggers.text: Turn it up. No. Down. This is a copy of a copy of something we did first.
triggers.note: The song title from the radio, his critic's ear, no lyrics. The rock filter cannot be checked, so any radio song can trigger it.

triggers.text: You're up. I'm up. We're a pair of insomniacs sharing a skull.
triggers.note: The hour and V's activity. He may bring up Alt in two sentences if the bond is 5 or more.

triggers.text: Look at that tower. Bigger than the last one. They always rebuild bigger.
triggers.note: The district, Arasaka, his 2023 guilt, and V's last view of the tower.

triggers.text: That went... better than I expected. Rogue looked at me. Through you. I felt it.
triggers.note: Rogue's role, the hunt for Smasher, and Johnny's unresolved history with her.

triggers.text: That was fine. I'll deny it. But it was fine.
triggers.note: The quest just finished, its ending, and what he took from it.
